messages:
sec-bot: Threat intel alert: Observed active exploitation of an unauthenticated Redis Sentinel endpoint leading to credential disclosure (reports from multiple cloud providers). Marked as exploited-in-the-wild.
anya: ack. which versions are affected? any public CVE id yet?
sec-bot: preliminary vendor advisory points to Sentinel < 6.4.12 and some 6.0.x builds when configured with legacy ACLs. No CVE number publicized by vendor at time of alert, but multiple PoCs circulating.
matt: are any of our clusters running Sentinel exposed to the internet or peered networks that could be abused? listing now.
oncall-sre: running quick query against inventory, returning hosts with port 26379 open to 0.0.0.0: 3 production autoscaling groups, 2 staging clusters, 1 customer-managed VPC we host connectors for.
anya: action items: 1) immediate network mitigation (block external 26379), 2) patch redis-sentinel to vendor fixed build where we manage it, 3) rotate any credentials that may have been exposed, 4) customer comms if impacted. Assign.
eng-infra: I'll push firewall rules to block 26379 at edge load balancer + host-level iptables for defense-in-depth. Pushing change now.
matt: starting emergency deploy plan for our managed redis images. PR with patched image tag and canary rollout. Will hold rollout behind a kill switch until infra confirms network block.
oncall-sre: infra change applied to edge LB: deny tcp 26379 from all external CIDRs. Host iptables job queued. Confirm when host rules are live.
eng-infra: host iptables pushed to prod pool-1 and pool-2, reporting 26379 blocked from non-private ranges. Verified with external nmap from three vantage points.
anya: good. matt, once you have the patched image PR ready tag the canary for non-critical clusters first. keep canary at 1 node for 1 hour and check logs.
matt: PR: https://stash.internal/r/redwood/redis-images/pull/542 - image: redwood/redis:6.4.12-rw1. Canary started in canary-prod namespace (instance id canary-redis-21). Logs look clean so far.
nora: for the connector we run in customer-managed VPCs, we can't push image. we need a mitigation checklist to hand to SRE/SEs at customers: 1) block sentinel port at firewall, 2) apply vendor patch, 3) rotate credentials used by connectors.
olivia: drafting customer-facing advisory now. include: short description, what we did (network block + managed patch rollout plan), recommended immediate actions for self-hosted customers, ETA for full rollout. Will share draft for review in 20m.
legal: please add non-technical impact wording and SLO/contract commentary. No promises on data exposure until we finish forensic checks. Keep language conservative.
anya: forensic task: snapshot affected instances, capture redis configs (sentinel.conf, ACLs), check KMS key access logs for any unusual activity around credential rotation windows. assign to matt + sec team.
matt: forensic snapshots taken for the 3 prod ASGs and the 2 staging clusters. Uploading to secured bucket s3://redwood-sec/forensics/1798213456/. KMS audit shows no suspicious decrypt ops in the last 72h.
sec-bot: note: we observed suspicious sentinel AUTH attempts from IP ranges linked to known botnets — added to internal blocklist.
anya: timeline for managed rollout?
matt: can do full managed rollout in 3 hours after canary window, will throttle and monitor metrics: redis uptime, latency, failed connections, error logs for sentinel auth.
olivia: customer advisory draft posted: https://docs.internal/redwood/security/1798213456-redis-sentinel-advisory-draft.md please review. callout: customers with public sentinel endpoints are HIGH priority.
eng-infra: FYI, internal monitoring alert rule added: sentinel port exposure -> Pager to eng-security + oncall. Also created temporary WAF rule to drop requests with sentinel protocol signatures.
legal: received the advisory draft, will review wording, suggest replacing 'credential disclosure' with 'potential exposure of sentinel-managed credentials' until confirmed.
anya: recap + owners: eng-infra: network block (done), matt: patch canary -> full rollout (in progress), sec: forensic review (in progress), olivia: customer comms (drafted), legal: disclosure wording (reviewing), nora: customer-run checklist for connectors. ETA: full managed rollout + comms within 4 hours.
oncall-sre: monitoring hooks: added metric dashboards for sentinel auth errors, KMS decrypt spike graph, and a tag-based search for any service using sentinel ACLs.
matt: managed rollout complete across all managed clusters at 1798214680, no regressions observed in 10m post-rollout. continuing to monitor.
anya: good. sec: final ask: rotate creds for any tenants that had sentinel endpoints exposed and log rotation in KMS. Provide list to customer-success for outreach.
sec-bot: rotation job started for impacted tenants (ids: r-112, r-117, r-189). job will rotate in 30m windows and emit events to audit log.
olivia: final advisory posted and sent to affected customers with mitigation steps and our remediation timeline. link to FAQ included.
legal: approved final advisory wording.
nora: shared connector checklist with PMs for notifying customers who manage their own infra.
anya: closing actionable items: monitoring for 72h, finalize postmortem with timeline and gaps, confirm no customer data exfiltration. will open postmortem thread after 72h. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
